ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat / ALPHV Rust ransomware execution via signature --access-token CLI flags
ucs.description: Detects execution of the BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus Rust-based ransomware binary, which uniquely requires a 32+ char `--access-token` argument plus a documented set of companion flags (`--paths`, `--propagated`, `--no-prop-servers`, `--no-prop-wrks`, `--no-vm-kill`, `--no-vm-snapshot-kill`, `--child`). This CLI scheme is a near-unique BlackCat fingerprint (CrowdStrike tracks the affiliates as SLIPPY SPIDER-adjacent / TWISTED SPIDER ecosystem; Microsoft DEV-0237 / Storm-0875; Mandiant UNC2596 / FIN7-overlap affiliates) and is anti-analysis tradecraft — the binary refuses to detonate without the tok
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-wrks*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--no-vm-snapshot-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--prop-file*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where (match(process, "(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{32,}") OR (match(process, "(?i)--access-token") AND match(process, "(?i)--paths")) OR match(process, "(?i)--no-prop-(servers|wrks)") OR match(process, "(?i)--no-vm-(kill|snapshot-kill)")) AND NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name process parent hash count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-prop-wrks", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill", "--propagated", "--prop-file")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{32,}"
   or (ProcessCommandLine has "--access-token" and ProcessCommandLine has "--paths")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--no-prop-servers", "--no-prop-wrks", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          SHA256, MD5
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token", "--no-prop-servers", "--no-prop-wrks", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill", "--propagated", "--prop-file")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{32,}"
   or (CommandLine has "--access-token" and CommandLine has "--paths")
   or CommandLine has_any ("--no-prop-servers", "--no-prop-wrks", "--no-vm-kill", "--no-vm-snapshot-kill")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, AccountName = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackCat/ALPHV Ransomware Execution via Signature --access-token CLI Flags
id: 9c4f1d2a-7e3b-4a6f-9d8c-blackcat-cli-2026
status: experimental
description: Detects BlackCat/ALPHV/Noberus Rust ransomware execution. The binary requires a 32+ char --access-token argument plus characteristic propagation/VM flags that no benign software ships with.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc2596-blackcat-ransomware
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/carbon-spider-embraces-big-game-hunting-part-1/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_token:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{32,}'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--no-prop-servers'
      - '--no-prop-wrks'
      - '--no-vm-kill'
      - '--no-vm-snapshot-kill'
      - '--propagated'
      - '--prop-file'
  selection_pair:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '--access-token'
      - '--paths'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_token or selection_flags or selection_pair) and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Extremely unlikely; the --access-token + --paths combo is a documented BlackCat-only signature.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1) OR (source:windows.security @EventID:4688) AND (@CommandLine:*--access-token* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-servers* OR @CommandLine:*--no-prop-wrks* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-snapshot-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--propagated* OR @CommandLine:*--prop-file* OR @CommandLine:*--ACCESS-TOKEN*) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine=/--access-token\s+[a-f0-9]{32,}/i OR CommandLine=/--no-prop-(servers|wrks)/i OR CommandLine=/--no-vm-(kill|snapshot-kill)/i OR CommandLine=/--propagated/i OR CommandLine=/--prop-file/i OR (CommandLine=/--access-token/i AND CommandLine=/--paths/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=executions), collect(CommandLine, multival=false, limit=3), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: BlackCat's Rust binary is uniquely identified by its `--access-token <32+ hex>` argument — added as anti-analysis so sandboxes that lack the token cannot detonate it. Combined with BlackCat-specific propagation flags (`--no-prop-servers`, `--no-prop-wrks`, `--prop-file`) and VM-quiescence flags (`--no-vm-kill`, `--no-vm-snapshot-kill`), this is essentially a signature for the live encryptor regard

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat affiliate pre-encryption recovery-inhibit choreography (vssadmin + wmic + bcdedit + iisreset + net stop)
ucs.description: Detects the documented BlackCat/ALPHV staging chain executed in the minutes before encryption — affiliates consistently run vssadmin shadow deletion, wmic shadowcopy delete, bcdedit recovery disable, iisreset /stop, and `net stop` against backup/SQL/Exchange services from the same host/session, often spawned from a single batch script or the BlackCat binary's --child mode. Fires when ≥2 distinct behaviors in this set occur on one host within 10 minutes — a high-fidelity terminal-stage indicator.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" Processes.process="*delete*" Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*")) OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" Processes.process="*stop*" (Processes.process="*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*mssql*" OR Processes.process="*sqlserver*" OR Processes.process="*backupexec*" OR Processes.process="*MSExchange*")) OR (Processes.process_name="iisreset.exe" Processes.process="*/stop*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval behavior=case(process_name="vssadmin.exe","vssadmin_delete_shadows", process_name="wmic.exe","wmic_shadow_delete", process_name="bcdedit.exe","bcdedit_inhibit_recovery", process_name="net.exe","net_stop_backup_sql", process_name="iisreset.exe","iisreset_stop") | stats values(behavior) as behaviors dc(behavior) as behavior_count min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parents) as parents by dest user | where behavior_count >= 2 AND NOT match(user, "\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Behavior = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows", "vssadmin_delete_shadows",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "wmic_shadow_delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "safeboot"), "bcdedit_inhibit_recovery",
    FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("veeam", "mssql", "sqlserver", "backupexec", "msexchange", "sophos"), "net_stop_backup_sql",
    FileName =~ "iisreset.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/stop", "iisreset_stop",
    FileName =~ "fsutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "behavior" and ProcessCommandLine has "SymlinkEvaluation", "fsutil_symlink_remote",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Behavior)
| summarize Behaviors      = make_set(Behavior),
            BehaviorCount  = dcount(Behavior),
            FirstSeen      = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen       = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds     = make_list(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            ParentSet      = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where BehaviorCount >= 2     // 2+ distinct behaviors in a 10m window = pre-encryption chain
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend Behavior = case(
    ProcName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows", "vssadmin_delete_shadows",
    ProcName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete", "wmic_shadow_delete",
    ProcName == "bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has "recoveryenabled no" or CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures" or CommandLine has "safeboot"), "bcdedit_inhibit_recovery",
    ProcName == "net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and (CommandLine has "veeam" or CommandLine has "mssql" or CommandLine has "sqlserver" or CommandLine has "backupexec" or CommandLine has "msexchange"), "net_stop_backup_sql",
    ProcName == "iisreset.exe" and CommandLine has "/stop", "iisreset_stop",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Behavior)
| summarize Behaviors     = make_set(Behavior),
            BehaviorCount = dcount(Behavior),
            FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen      = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds    = make_list(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents       = make_set(ParentProcessName)
          by Computer, AccountName = SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where BehaviorCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1) OR (source:windows.security @EventID:4688) AND ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete* AND @CommandLine:*shadows*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND (@CommandLine:*recoveryenabled* OR @CommandLine:*bootstatuspolicy* OR @CommandLine:*safeboot*)) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND (@CommandLine:*veeam* OR @CommandLine:*mssql* OR @CommandLine:*sqlserver* OR @CommandLine:*backupexec* OR @CommandLine:*MSExchange*)) OR (@Image:(*\\iisreset.exe OR *\\IISReset.exe OR *\\IISRESET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*/stop*)) -@User:*$ -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.rationale: Every BlackCat/ALPHV intrusion report from Microsoft (DEV-0237 / Storm-0875), Mandiant (UNC2596 / UNC4014), and CrowdStrike documents the same pre-encryption choreography: shadow copy nuking via vssadmin + wmic, boot-recovery disable via bcdedit, IIS halt, and net stop against backup/SQL/Exchange — frequently chained inside one cmd.exe batch or spawned by the encryptor's --child mode.
